description.zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，支持300、3600、14400、28800和86400秒。

不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒。
description.en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Valid values: 300, 3600, 14400, 28800, and 86400. Unit: seconds.

If you do not set this parameter or set it to an unsupported value, the default value 300 is used.
The resource ID of the current bill.

title.zh: 获取用户已出账单消费周期
title.en: Retrieve billing cycles of issued bills

descriptions.zh: 当用户有多于1个业务类型（live、vod、download）时，不同业务单独输出消费时间和计量数据。
descriptions.en: When a user has more than one service type (live, vod, or download), the consumption time and metering data are output separately for each service type.
